title: CodexVerdict
description: The brain's decision after reviewing one executor result card. Every property is listed in `required` because the structured-output endpoint rejects optional properties; use null or an empty array for 'not applicable'.

action.description: pass = accepted, stop here. rework = fix and resubmit. next = accepted, execute nextTask now. stop = halt the run.

reason.description: Why this decision. One or two sentences.

feedbackForExecutor.description: Short actionable message for the executor. Use "none" when there is nothing to add.

reworkInstructions.description: Required when action is rework: exactly what to change and how to verify it. Use null otherwise.

nextTask.description: Required when action is next. The single next task, fully self-contained. Use null otherwise.

verification.description: How the executor must prove the work is done.

constraints.description: Empty array when there are none.

dependsOn.description: Empty array when there are none.

additionalTasks.description: Extra tasks to append to the queue (not executed now). Empty array when there are none.

summaryForRolling.description: One line kept in the rolling summary. Keep it within summary.oneLineMaxChars (400 by default); the bridge trims anything longer.

tokensEstimate.description: Optional self-estimate of tokens used. The bridge uses measured usage, so null is fine.
